WITH grouped_data AS (
  SELECT 
    ili.order_item_id,
    p.product_color,
    AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS avg_quantity,
    AVG(
      CASE 
        WHEN ili.derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL 
          AND ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL 
          AND ili.derived_total_cost != 0
        THEN (ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / ili.derived_total_cost
      END
    ) AS avg_cost_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  INNER JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE ili.order_item_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color
),
ranked_data AS (
  SELECT 
    order_item_id,
    product_color,
    avg_quantity,
    avg_cost_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_color ORDER BY avg_quantity DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank
  FROM grouped_data
)
SELECT 
  order_item_id,
  product_color,
  avg_quantity,
  avg_cost_ratio,
  rank
FROM ranked_data
WHERE rank <= 3;

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity (VARCHAR(50) in schema) contains numeric values that can be cast to DECIMAL for averaging
derived_total_cost = 0 should be excluded from the cost ratio calculation to avoid division by zero
NULLS LAST syntax is supported by the target database (standard SQL; available in MySQL 8.0+, PostgreSQL, etc.)
